key_insight: Symbal detects recurring captioning mistakes in multimodal models by linking a specific visual feature to a systematic error pattern, without needing access to the underlying model.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging and clinical NLP workflows, this could help audit image-caption datasets and catch misleading generated descriptions before they affect downstream use.
method: Uses a structured two-stage pipeline built on off-the-shelf foundation models
Identifies systematic misalignments in image-text pairs
Summarizes detected error patterns in natural language
evidence_signal: On SymbalBench, 1.7 million image-text pairs across 420 datasets from natural and medical domains were used, and Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets, about 4× better than the closest baseline.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-dependent, so real-world deployment still needs careful validation across new datasets, prompts, and image domains.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
